1. I got it! Let me show you what I learned if others are having trouble with this achievement too.
Basically, if you have Luigi as a Jamboree buddy, there's a good chance he'll help you get three 10s.
Here are some tips to get you a Luigi and a Triple Dice at the same time:
1. Triple Dice are easier to find in Roll em Raceway, Goomba Lagoon Pro Mode, and Mario's Rainbow Castle. Find em at Koopa Shop.
2. Play against CPUs, wait for a turn where a Jamboree Buddy appears, and if the character isn't Luigi, then save-scum back to the start of that turn to re-roll the Buddy character.
...
1. The best odds of getting it to pop up is playing a game of 15 turns or more, being in 3rd or 4th place, during the last 5-6 turns of the game. Once those conditions are met, it shows up during the item space roulette or item space minigame.
My tactic was to play at the galleria, use the first 14 rounds to stay low in the standings and stack up on custom dice blocks. You can also increase your chances by having a jamboree buddy to get extra interactions on the item space during those last 5 turns if you're lucky enough to have the locations work out right.
...
2. The easiest method:
Get Luigi as a Jamboree buddy.
Have a triple dice.
Use the triple dice with Luigi. He will swap the role to all 10s. This worked for me immediately.
...
3. There is no cheese, nor anyway to guarantee the roll. However, the board with the most triple dice available is the race track board (Roll 'Em Raceway) so I'd start by playing games against the easiest AI there (or with friends if they need the achievement too). Cheers.
...
4. Hey again, just did the math - it's a 1/10000 (0.01%) chance to roll three of the same number. It might take a while, but good luck.

- Your Mushroom change: 1-3 Dice block +5.
- (Payday) Double / Triple: first block only is 1-3, the second and third are standard 1-10 (per the previous reply)

Custom Block is already 12 coins so I wouldn't nerf it like that with a Creepy Block. I think it's fine for the Custom Block to still cancel it out and let you pick a 1-10 roll. 12 coins to completely counter a 3 coin item is more than fair I feel. As for the Turbo dice, I didn't mention them but that's because a) they may just be a one time item for this game due to being in only one board, and b) they already kinda suck if you ask me, yeah 4 dice is great but you are forced to pass everything, star included. I would let them still cancel Creepy dice given that. When given the choice I'd always rather have Triple > Turbo
